text: Todos los plugins de tipo "plagiarism" sirven para detectar plagio en las tareas entregadas por los estudiantes. Algunos ejemplos son [plagiarism_copycheck], [plagiarism_turnitin], [plagiarism_pd], [plagiarism_turnitinsim], [plagiarism_origai], [plagiarism_originality], [plagiarism_plagiarisma], [plagiarism_unicheck], [plagiarism_unplag], [plagiarism_dupli], [plagiarism_urkund], [plagiarism_pchkorg], [plagiarism_sst], [plagiarism_edfast], [plagiarism_copyleaks], [plagiarism_plagiarismsearch], [plagiarism_strike], [plagiarism_crot], [plagiarism_safeassign] y [plagiarism_drillbit].
